article_title: Significant drop in levels of toxic 'forever' chemicals in English rivers

tasks.prompt: What is the main finding reported by the Environment Agency?
options: River concentrations of PFOS and PFOA have fallen by nearly a third in a decade
All PFAS have disappeared from England's rivers
The UK has stopped testing rivers for toxic chemicals
Fresh-water fish now contain more PFAS than ten years ago
tasks.correct_answer: River concentrations of PFOS and PFOA have fallen by nearly a third in a decade
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנתונים מראים שריכוזי PFOS ו־PFOA בנהרות אנגליה ירדו בכמעט שליש בעשר שנים.

tasks.prompt: What explanation is given for the decline in PFOS and PFOA?
options: More rivers were diverted into the sea
Factories voluntarily stopped all chemical production
Stricter restrictions reduced their use in products
Fish began breaking the chemicals down naturally
tasks.correct_answer: Stricter restrictions reduced their use in products
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הירידה מיוחסת להגבלות מחמירות יותר על השימוש בכימיקלים לאחר שהתגלו נזקיהם.

tasks.prompt: How much did levels of the chemicals in fresh-water fish fall?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי דו״ח הסוכנות, הרמות בדגי מים מתוקים ירדו ב־49%.

options: They are used only in permanent buildings
They were invented thousands of years ago
They can be recycled without limit
They resist natural breakdown and remain for a very long time
tasks.correct_answer: They resist natural breakdown and remain for a very long time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העמידות הטבעית של PFAS גורמת לכך שהם מתפרקים לאט מאוד ולכן מכונים כימיקלים נצחיים.

tasks.prompt: When were PFOS and PFOA largely banned in the UK?
options: PFOS in 2010 and PFOA in 2020
Both chemicals in 1930
PFOS in 2020 and PFOA in 2010
Both chemicals in 2026
tasks.explanation_hebrew: PFOS נאסר כמעט לחלוטין ב־2010 ו־PFOA ב־2020.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “diluted” mean?
options: Permanently destroyed by heat
Made more toxic through mixing
Spread through more water so the concentration becomes lower
Stored safely in medical equipment
tasks.correct_answer: Spread through more water so the concentration becomes lower
tasks.explanation_hebrew: diluted פירושו מדולל: אותה כמות מתפזרת ביותר מים ולכן הריכוז הנמדד יורד.

tasks.prompt: Why does the report warn that lower river concentrations do not necessarily mean less PFAS exists in the environment?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין ריכוז לכמות כוללת ולהתייחס לדילול ולזרימה לים.
expected_points: The chemicals may have been diluted rather than destroyed
Some contamination may have washed from rivers into the sea
The total environmental amount may therefore remain broadly unchanged

tasks.prompt: Summarise the evidence that restrictions worked and the reasons the Environment Agency says further regulation is still needed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את נתוני הירידה עם אי־הוודאות והיקף משפחת PFAS.
expected_points: PFOS concentrations fell 30% and PFOA concentrations fell 29% over ten years
Around 15,000 other PFAS may exist and only about 200 are frequently used
The toxicity of many PFAS remains uncertain
The agency argues for monitoring and regulating PFAS as a group

tasks.prompt: Why is permanent removal of PFAS described as difficult in the UK?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין הן את העמידות הכימית והן את מגבלת מתקני ההשמדה.
expected_points: High-temperature incineration is one of the few permanent destruction methods
Only two suitable incineration sites currently exist in the country

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining one benefit and one risk of PFAS use, using examples from the report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג תכונה שימושית ודוגמה למוצר, מול נזק או סיכון בריאותי/סביבתי מתועד.
expected_points: Useful properties include resistance to oil or water, low friction or electrochemical performance
Examples include outdoor clothing, cookware, firefighting foam, medical equipment or batteries
PFOS and PFOA have been linked to animal tissue damage and serious health conditions
Their persistence allows them to accumulate or remain in the environment
